claude_proposed_widenings.name: menu_activation
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Channel Divinity is a use-count pool that, on activation, dispatches to one of N named sub-effects chosen by the player. ClassFeatureActivationMechanics has a singular `effect` field; it cannot represent a choosable menu without fabricating a single effect that does not match any sub-effect honestly.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Each time you use this class's Channel Divinity, choose which Channel Divinity effect from this class to create.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureActivationCost: action / magic_action
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Both Divine Spark and Turn Undead cost a Magic action. ClassFeatureActivationCost only has `free` and `bonus_action`. A Magic action consumes the character's Action quota and is the specific `magic` StandardActionKind — distinct from both free and bonus-action costs.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: As a Magic action, you point your Holy Symbol at another creature... / As a Magic action, you present your Holy Symbol and censure Undead creatures.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: DiceExpr: ability_modifier addend
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Divine Spark's heal/damage amount is 1d8 + Wisdom modifier, where the Wis modifier is a runtime value derived from the character sheet. DiceExpr.flat is a fixed integer with no way to express 'add an ability score modifier'.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Roll 1d8 and add your Wisdom modifier.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureEffect: player_choice_fork (heal or save_gate_damage)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Divine Spark lets the cleric choose at activation time between healing the target or forcing a CON save for damage. This is a deterministic caster election (not a resolution branch). No ClassFeatureEffect variant models a player-directed fork between heal and damage-with-save.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You either restore Hit Points to the creature equal to that total or force the creature to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes Necrotic or Radiant damage (your choice) equal to that total.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureEffect: apply_condition (multi-condition, timed, early-expiry)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Turn Undead applies Frightened and Incapacitated simultaneously for up to 1 minute, with three early-expiry conditions. ClassFeatureEffect only has GrantExtraActionEffect and HealHpEffect; neither covers condition application.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: it has the Frightened and Incapacitated conditions for 1 minute... This effect ends early on the creature if it takes any damage, if you have the Incapacitated condition, or if you die.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: Condition: frightened, incapacitated (and others beyond prone)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The Condition type is a closed enum containing only `prone`. Turn Undead requires `frightened` and `incapacitated`. Widening Condition is a prerequisite for any apply_condition effect variant.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: it has the Frightened and Incapacitated conditions for 1 minute
